The Chinese characters for Marcus

As a transliteration, Marcus is usually written 马库斯 (Mǎ kù sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

The name Marcus has Latin roots and means “dedicated to Mars (the god of war)”.

About the name Marcus

A Roman name tied to Mars, and the name of the emperor Marcus Aurelius.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Marcus suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
